business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a café with 12 staff', 'a three-person electrical contractor'.

tools.name: training_status
tools.description: Who needs which course within the next 30 days, one list per course with lapsed certificates first, then training never done, then certificates about to run out, each with person and course ids and any booking. Call it first when asked who needs a course, what is expiring, or where someone stands.

tools.name: add_person
tools.description: Add someone to the training tracker or update them: full name, job role (it decides which courses they need) and first day. An existing name is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a new person is mentioned, before you describe them. Use personStatus 'left' when someone leaves.

tools.name: add_course
tools.description: Add or update a course or certificate the business tracks: title, months it stays valid (0 if it never expires), who needs it ('everyone' or roles such as 'barista, cook') and the provider. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a course is mentioned.

tools.name: record_completion
tools.description: Record that one or more people finished a course: person (a name, or several separated by commas), course, the day (default today) and the certificate number exactly as given. The expiry date is worked out from the course. Call it the moment the person reports it, before you reply.

tools.name: book_training
tools.description: Book a session: course, the date (YYYY-MM-DD or a weekday like 'thursday', which the tracker turns into the date), and either person (one or several, comma-separated) or everyoneDue: true for everyone whose certificate has lapsed, runs out within 30 days, or was never done. Call it as soon as the person asks.

tools.name: save_quiz
tools.description: Save a short quiz written from the business's own document: title, the course it supports, the source document, and questions, one per line as 'Question? | right answer | wrong answer | wrong answer'. Read the document first and quote it accurately. An existing title is replaced.

tools.name: list_training
tools.description: Everyone's training, or one person's: each course they need with its status, dates, certificate and booking.
